description: Siticone NetCoreUI is a modern UI library for .NET 8 and above. Build fast, sleek, and high-performance WinForms desktop apps with hardware-accelerated, pixel-perfect controls—seamlessly integrated for a polished, modern experience.
releaseNotes:
Siticone UI - Key Improvements:

IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ BEFORE UPDATING:
• Back up your existing projects before updating.
• Read the changelog below carefully before updating your library version.
• Contact Siticone support before updating if you have questions or need clarification.
• Test the new version in a separate test project before applying it to a production project.

IMPROVEMENTS:
We have made general updates to the library components and controls.

Updates:
==========

1. Siticone Advanced Text Area:
- Fixed character and word counters.
- Improved counter visibility across sizes, fonts, padding, and DPI scales.
- Added automatic counter-height adjustment.
- Added customizable character, word, line, limit, and remaining-character labels.
- Added support for custom counter separators and fully localized counter text.
- Added optional line-count and remaining-character counters.
- Added configurable character limits, limit enforcement, and warning thresholds.
- Added customizable counter fonts, colors, alignment, padding, borders, height, and ellipsis behavior.
- Added automatic content-based control sizing.
- Added enhanced text statistics, selection, line-change, modification, and character-limit events.
- Organized properties and events under clearly branded Siticone categories.
- Improved quick actions with a wider layout and automatic display.
- Fixed cleared PlaceholderText values reappearing after running and stopping the application.
- Added customizable placeholder text color.

2. Siticone Snack Bar:
- Improved Snackbar message rendering to prevent text from being cut or truncated.
- Added automatic width and height adjustment based on message content.
- Added customizable automatic, multiline wrapping, and single-line display modes.
- Added customizable minimum width, maximum width, fixed width, minimum height, padding, and spacing.
- Added multiple professionally designed Snackbar theme presets.
- Improved color isolation so Snackbar colors remain unaffected by application or parent form themes.
- Added customizable background, text, border, action, close button, and progress indicator colors.
- Added support for optional icons, clickable actions, close buttons, and auto-close progress indicators.
- Added customizable Snackbar screen positions, edge margins, offsets, and display-area settings.
- Added slide, fade, combined slide-and-fade, and instant display animations.
- Added customizable animation duration, animation distance, opacity, and display duration.
- Added automatic dismissal, click-to-dismiss, pause-on-hover, and manual dismissal options.
- Added options to ignore or replace an already visible Snackbar message.
- Added comprehensive lifecycle, interaction, timing, replacement, and dismissal events.
- Enhanced event information with message details, display bounds, duration, remaining time, mouse information, and dismissal reasons.
- Added cancelable opening and closing events for greater application control.
- Added right-to-left layout support and customizable text alignment.
- Improved DPI scaling for consistent display across different screen configurations.
- Added comprehensive Visual Studio smart-tag support for faster component customization.
